topic: How to pick the right business category on Google Maps
caption:
Your Google Maps category is not a label. It is a ranking signal.
Pick the wrong one and Google hands your customers to a competitor.
Choose your most specific primary category first, then add secondaries.
We set this up right for every site we build. Link in bio.

copy.headline: Wrong category on Google Maps costs you customers
copy.body: Your primary category tells Google what you are. Pick a vague one and competitors with specific categories rank above you every time.
